rules.name: RTOS primitives in user-space (ebin)
rules.rationale: FreeRTOS primitives are forbidden in user applications; apps must use standard POSIX / EOS abstractions.

rules.name: ESP-IDF vendor hardware/bus APIs in core kernel (ecore)
rules.rationale: Kernel core must use driver abstractions, not direct vendor bus APIs.

rules.name: ESP-IDF vendor hardware/bus APIs in user-space (ebin)
rules.rationale: User applications must interact with peripherals via /dev and standard syscalls.

rules.name: Raw printf/puts in drivers (edriver)
rules.rationale: Drivers must use EOS_LOG macros instead of raw stdout output.

rules.name: Direct ESP-IDF HTTP client in user-space (ebin)
rules.rationale: User applications must use curl compatibility layer rather than direct vendor HTTP client (T05).

rules.name: Direct ESP-IDF HTTP server in user-space (ebin)
rules.rationale: HTTP servers must use libmicrohttpd compatibility layer rather than direct vendor HTTP server (T11).

rules.name: Direct NVS access outside NVS driver
rules.rationale: NVS storage must be accessed exclusively through the /dev/nvs filesystem driver (T22).

rules.name: Direct IDF VFS registration in apps
rules.rationale: VFS operations belong strictly in core kernel (ecore) and linker wrappers (T07, T12).

rules.name: Unauthorized global/static variables in main/ebin
rules.rationale: Applications must not use unmanaged file-scope state to ensure clean restarts and thread safety.

rules.name: Unauthorized global/static variables in main/edriver
rules.rationale: Drivers must store instance state in eos_drv_t / device contexts.

rules.name: Missing #pragma once in header files
rules.rationale: All header files must contain #pragma once or include guards.

rules.name: Linker scripts (.ld, .lf) outside main/eld
rules.rationale: All custom linker scripts must reside in main/eld.

rules.name: __wrap_* wrapper definitions outside main/ewrap
rules.rationale: Linker wrap definitions must reside exclusively in main/ewrap.

rules.name: Driver source files (.c) missing EOS_DRV_*_ENABLED guard
rules.rationale: Every driver C source file must be guarded by its Kconfig enable macro.

rules.name: Driver directories missing eos_drv_t / eos_driver_t definition
rules.rationale: Every driver module folder must declare a driver structure and no loose files may exist.

rules.name: No blocking/real I/O calls while eos_vfs_* lock held
rules.rationale: Real VFS/filesystem I/O calls must never be executed while holding central VFS locks to prevent deadlocks and blocking stalls.

rules.name: Ad-hoc PATH tokenization outside ecore
rules.rationale: Executable PATH resolution must use a single canonical helper in main/ecore rather than duplicating strtok_r loops.

rules.name: Monolithic subcommand strcmp chains in ebin
rules.rationale: CLI tools with more than 5 subcommands must use a const subcommand dispatch table and centralize device open/close.

rules.name: Function length, cyclomatic complexity, and nesting limits
rules.rationale: Functions must remain small, flat, and single-purpose; split large ioctls and command evaluators into static helpers.

rules.name: Copy-pasted code blocks across files
rules.rationale: Shared logic of 8+ normalized lines across multiple files must be extracted into main/emisc/ or a shared subsystem helper.

rules.name: Macro constants (#define) inside .c files instead of .h headers
rules.rationale: All #define constants and configuration macros must reside in .h header files so hardware dimensions, limits, and protocol constants have a single source of truth.

rules.name: Hardcoded magic numbers and raw array bounds in .c files

flagged_literals.0x0B1120: LVGL theme background color (use EOS_THEME_BG_COLOR in header)
flagged_literals.0x0F172A: LVGL theme panel color (use EOS_THEME_PANEL_COLOR in header)
flagged_literals.0x1E293B: LVGL theme surface color (use EOS_THEME_SURFACE_COLOR in header)
flagged_literals.0x94A3B8: LVGL theme muted text color (use EOS_THEME_TEXT_MUTED in header)
flagged_literals.0x34D399: LVGL theme accent color (use EOS_THEME_ACCENT_GREEN in header)
flagged_literals.0xFDE047: LVGL theme highlight color (use EOS_THEME_HIGHLIGHT_YELLOW in header)
flagged_literals.0x38BDF8: LVGL theme info color (use EOS_THEME_INFO_BLUE in header)
flagged_literals.0x334155: LVGL theme border color (use EOS_THEME_BORDER_COLOR in header)
flagged_literals.128: Buffer/size constant (use EOS_SMALL_STR_LEN or named header macro)
flagged_literals.256: Buffer/size constant (use EOS_MID_STR_LEN or named header macro)
flagged_literals.512: Sector/buffer size constant (use EOS_SECTOR_SIZE or named header macro)
flagged_literals.1024: Buffer/KibiByte constant (use EOS_LARGE_STR_LEN or named header macro)
flagged_literals.4096: Page/chunk size constant (use EOS_XLARGE_STR_LEN or named header macro)
flagged_literals.8192: DMA/strip size constant (use named header macro)
flagged_literals.16384: DMA/strip size constant (use named header macro)
flagged_literals.12288: Thread stack size constant (use EOS_BIN_*_STACK_SIZE in header)
flagged_literals.1000: Time/unit conversion factor (use EOS_MS_PER_SEC / EOS_US_PER_MS in header)
flagged_literals.10000: Timeout/poll interval constant (use named timeout macro in header)
flagged_literals.1000000: Microsecond conversion/sleep constant (use EOS_US_PER_SEC in header)
flagged_literals.0755: POSIX directory/exec mode (use EOS_DEFAULT_DIR_MODE in header)
flagged_literals.0644: POSIX file mode (use EOS_DEFAULT_FILE_MODE in header)
flagged_literals.0666: POSIX device/pipe mode (use EOS_DEFAULT_DEV_MODE in header)
flagged_literals.0x08: I2C minimum 7-bit address (use EOS_I2C_ADDR_MIN in header)
flagged_literals.0x77: I2C maximum 7-bit scan address (use EOS_I2C_ADDR_SCAN_MAX in header)
flagged_literals.0x7F: I2C 7-bit address ceiling (use EOS_I2C_ADDR_MAX in header)

rules.rationale: Hardware dimensions, pixel formats, UI theme colors, buffer sizes, timeouts, and file modes must be defined as named macros in .h headers rather than scattered as magic numbers in .c files.

rules.name: emisc must not include OS, IDF, hardware or upper-layer headers
rules.rationale: AGENTS.md: emisc has zero OS/hardware dependencies. psram_alloc.h is excluded because it includes the IDF header only under __has_include.

rules.name: emisc sources compile on the host (catches transitive IDF includes)
rules.rationale: A regex cannot see transitive includes. If gcc on a PC cannot parse the file, it depends on the target SDK.

rules.name: Every host test is run by CI
rules.rationale: hash_host_test.py broke at a9f5ea5 and stayed broken because CI never ran it.

rules.name: Constants must not be named after their own value
rules.rationale: EOS_DEFAULT_MAGIC_42 and EOS_TIMEOUT_5000_MS satisfy the magic-number rule without saying what the number means. Name the purpose, not the value.

rules.name: No global warning suppression flags
rules.rationale: Silencing a whole warning class hides deprecated IDF API use. Scope suppressions to one file with a pragma and a comment.

rules.name: No hard-coded framebuffer paths in ebin
rules.rationale: Apps get their display from EOS_FB (set by exec from the app role). Fallbacks belong in one shared helper.

rules.name: No behaviour keyed on FreeRTOS task names
rules.rationale: A user process named like a system task would be misclassified (the F02 'ipc' prefix bug). Use task flags.

rules.name: Test assertions must be able to fail
rules.rationale: F02 shipped report_test(..., true) checks that can never fail.

rules.name: fs.c must not replace specific errors with EIO
rules.rationale: Mount and umount failures all become EIO, which hides EBUSY, ENODEV and permission errors from the caller.

rules.name: No return between pthread_mutex_lock and unlock
rules.rationale: An early return on an error path while the mutex is held deadlocks the next caller. Needs the function-scope reset in the engine patch.

rules.name: ioctl codes appear in the docs (ratchet)
rules.rationale: Typed, documented ioctls (F08). Set max_undocumented to today's count first, then lower it.

rules.name: Docs must not contain machine-specific paths
rules.rationale: Absolute home-directory paths only work on one machine. Use $IDF_TOOLS_PATH or ~/.espressif.

rules.name: Diagnostic and event-listening test tools must implement bounded timeout and auto self-test options
rules.rationale: AGENTS.md §5: Any diagnostic binary that listens on an input stream or can wait for events (e.g. test_input, test_sound) must implement an automated self-test mode (--auto) and bounded timeouts (-t <ms>) to guarantee headless test execution without hanging.

rules.name: Filesystem registry structure and no loose files under main/efs
rules.rationale: AGENTS.md §3: Every filesystem directory under main/efs/<name>/ defines an eos_fs_type_t structure registered in the .eos_fs section (EOS_FS_ATTR eos_fs_type_t eos_fs_<name> = { ... };). No loose .c or .h files are permitted directly under main/efs/. All VFS registration calls (eos_vfs_register_ops, esp_vfs_register, etc.) must reside strictly inside eos_fs_type_t mount callbacks.

rules.name: No loose imperative filesystem init functions
rules.rationale: AGENTS.md §3: Imperative per-filesystem init functions (eos_*fs_init) are prohibited. All filesystem lifecycle, auto-mounts, and VFS ops registration must reside within eos_fs_type_t mount callbacks and be initialized declaratively via eos_fs_init().

rules.name: No direct hardware register access outside edriver
rules.rationale: Direct memory-mapped register access bypasses the Unified Device Model (/dev VFS and ioctl). Only low-level driver implementations in main/edriver/ may manipulate registers.

rules.name: No relative parent includes in main/
rules.rationale: Eliminates relative directory traversal escapes (#include "../../"). Subsystems must include cleanly via module roots (ecore/..., edriver/..., emisc/..., efs/...).

rules.name: No excessive stack buffer arrays in ebin
rules.rationale: User-space applications run in FreeRTOS tasks with constrained SRAM stacks (typically 4–8 KB). Declaring large arrays on the stack causes silent stack overflows; large buffers must be heap/PSRAM allocated.

rules.name: Bulk display and network buffers must reside in PSRAM
rules.rationale: AGENTS.md §4: Bulk buffers (framebuffers, render targets, packet capture rings) must not consume limited internal SRAM, requiring heap_caps_malloc(..., MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM) or psram allocation helpers.

rules.name: GUI logic files in ebin must not include LVGL or UI headers
rules.rationale: DEVELOPMENT.md §1: Business logic files (*_logic.c/h) must be strictly decoupled from UI presentation to allow headless unit testing.

rules.name: GUI applications under main/ebin/lvgl_* must decouple business logic into separate *_logic.c
rules.rationale: DEVELOPMENT.md §1 & AGENTS.md §2: All graphical applications (main/ebin/lvgl_*) must strictly decouple presentation from business logic into separate source files (*_logic.c / *_logic.h) to enable headless automated testing.

rules.name: Modal dialogs in ebin must use centralized eos_lvgl_dialog_* APIs
rules.rationale: DEVELOPMENT.md §7: Custom or ad-hoc message boxes (lv_msgbox_create) are forbidden; apps must use centralized eos_lvgl_dialog_confirm(), eos_lvgl_dialog_alert(), or eos_lvgl_dialog_info().

rules.name: Virtual keyboards in ebin must use centralized EOS keyboard APIs
rules.rationale: DEVELOPMENT.md §7: Direct instantiation of lv_keyboard_create in user applications is forbidden; apps must use centralized eos_lvgl_create_keyboard() or eos_lvgl_create_input_dialog().

rules.name: Menus and lists in ebin must use centralized eos_open_menu / eos_menu_* APIs
rules.rationale: AGENTS.md §2 & §3: Graphical applications must use centralized eos_open_menu() / eos_menu_create() instead of direct LVGL menu/list widgets.

rules.name: Hardware bus & storage lifecycle ordering in board init scripts (init.sh)
rules.rationale: AGENTS.md §3: Hardware buses (SDIO/SPI/I2C) and primary storage drivers must be attached before filesystems are mounted with 'mount -a', and USB mass storage backing must be attached after filesystems are mounted.

rules.name: GUI application theme unification and contrast standards
rules.rationale: AGENTS.md §2 & §7: GUI applications must strictly utilize centralized theme colors (EOS_THEME_* and EOS_COLOR_* from ecore/lvgl.h) rather than declaring ad-hoc color palettes, and must not use unreadable black/dark text on dark UI containers.

rules.name: Ban complex/fancy LVGL widgets and transforms unsuitable for small screens in ebin
rules.rationale: AGENTS.md §2 & §3: Complex/fancy LVGL widgets and scale transforms are unsuitable for compact handheld screens and keyboard-only navigation; use centralized eos_open_menu() and simple standard controls.

rules.name: USB drivers must not couple to storage-specific hardware handles or SDMMC/SPI-flash APIs
rules.rationale: AGENTS.md §3: USB drivers must remain storage-hardware agnostic and use generic EOS VFS device operations (eos_dev_read/write/lseek and generic storage ioctls) via esp_blockdev_t rather than SDMMC, SPI flash, or raw card handles.

rules.name: Forbid generic lock/mutex/sem field names without scope
rules.rationale: Lock and mutex fields must carry a descriptive scope-specific name (e.g., io_mutex, bus_mutex, state_mutex, ring_mutex) instead of generic 'lock'/'mutex'/'mtx'/'sem', so readers immediately know what invariant the lock protects.
